exposure: Gestational age at induction (39 weeks vs 40 weeks)
outcome: Educational test scores at grades 3, 5, and 7
cohort: Low-risk nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies in Victoria, Australia.
finding: Elective induction of labor at 39 weeks was associated with poorer educational outcomes at grade 3, while induction at 40 weeks was associated with poorer outcomes at grades 5 and 7, compared to expectant management.
